sections.explanation:
### Apa itu was dan were?
**Was** dan **were** adalah bentuk lampau (*past*) dari *to be* (am/is/are). Kita memakainya untuk membicarakan **tempat**, **keadaan**, **perasaan**, atau **deskripsi** di masa lalu.

| Present | Past | Dipakai untuk |
| --- | --- | --- |
| I am | I **was** | I |
| He / She / It is | He / She / It **was** | he, she, it, satu orang/benda |
| You / We / They are | You / We / They **were** | you, we, they, subjek jamak |

### Kapan dipakai?
- **Tempat**: *I was at home yesterday.* (Kemarin saya di rumah.)
- **Perasaan atau keadaan**: *We were tired after the trip.* (Kami lelah setelah perjalanan.)
- **Deskripsi**: *The film was very funny.* (Filmnya sangat lucu.)
- **Pekerjaan atau umur dulu**: *My grandfather was a teacher.* (Kakek saya dulu seorang guru.)

### Perbedaan dengan bahasa Indonesia
Dalam bahasa Indonesia, kata kerja tidak berubah untuk waktu lampau. Kita cukup menambahkan kata *kemarin*, *dulu*, atau *tadi*. Dalam bahasa Inggris, **bentuk kata kerjanya harus berubah**: *is → was*, *are → were*. Jadi kalimat *I am tired yesterday* salah; yang benar *I was tired yesterday*.

### Tips penting
1. **You** selalu memakai **were**, baik untuk satu orang maupun banyak orang: *You were late, Dika.*
2. Subjek jamak seperti *my parents*, *the children*, atau *Rina and Budi* memakai **were**.
3. Benda tunggal dan cuaca memakai **was**: *The room was clean. It was sunny.*
4. **Was** dan **were** tidak punya bentuk singkat dalam kalimat positif. Tulis *I was*, bukan *I's*.

### Remember
Subject + **was/were** + place / adjective / noun. Example: *Maya was at the library.*

sections.explanation:
### Kalimat negatif
Untuk membuat kalimat negatif, tambahkan **not** setelah was/were. Dalam percakapan, kita hampir selalu memakai bentuk singkat.

| Bentuk penuh | Bentuk singkat | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| was not | **wasn't** | *I wasn't at school yesterday.* |
| were not | **weren't** | *They weren't hungry.* |

### Pertanyaan yes/no
Untuk bertanya, **tukar posisi** subjek dan was/were. Tidak perlu kata bantu lain.

- *You were at home.* → **Were you** at home?
- *The test was easy.* → **Was the test** easy?

Jawaban singkat (*short answers*) mengulang was/were:

| Pertanyaan | Ya | Tidak |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Was she ...? | Yes, she **was**. | No, she **wasn't**. |
| Were they ...? | Yes, they **were**. | No, they **weren't**. |
| Were you ...? | Yes, I **was**. | No, I **wasn't**. |

Perhatikan: jika ditanya *Were you...?*, jawabannya memakai **I was / I wasn't** (bukan *I were*).

### Pertanyaan dengan kata tanya (wh-)
Pola: **Question word + was/were + subject + ...?**
- **Where were** you last night? (Di mana kamu tadi malam?)
- **How was** your weekend? (Bagaimana akhir pekanmu?)
- **Who was** at the party? (Siapa yang ada di pesta?)
- **Why were** you late? (Kenapa kamu terlambat?)
- **What was** the problem? (Apa masalahnya?)

### Catatan
*How was...?* sangat sering dipakai untuk menanyakan pengalaman: *How was the film? — It was great!* Jangan jawab dengan *Yes* atau *No*, karena ini bukan pertanyaan yes/no.

lessons.title: Yesterday, Last Week, Two Days Ago
lessons.summary: Memakai keterangan waktu lampau: yesterday, last..., ... ago, in + tahun.
objectives: Menggunakan yesterday, last, dan ago dengan benar
Menghindari kesalahan umum seperti yesterday night dan before two days
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Mengapa keterangan waktu penting?
Keterangan waktu (*time expressions*) memberi tahu **kapan** sesuatu terjadi. Saat kamu melihat kata seperti *yesterday* atau *ago*, kamu tahu bahwa kalimat itu harus memakai bentuk lampau (*was/were*).

### 1. Yesterday
| English | Indonesia |
| --- | --- |
| yesterday | kemarin |
| yesterday morning | kemarin pagi |
| yesterday afternoon | kemarin siang/sore |
| yesterday evening | kemarin sore/malam |
| **last night** | tadi malam / kemarin malam |
| the day before yesterday | kemarin lusa |

Perhatikan: orang Inggris berkata **last night**, bukan *yesterday night*.

### 2. Last + waktu
Dipakai tanpa *the* dan tanpa *on/in*: **last week**, **last month**, **last year**, **last Monday**, **last summer**, **last weekend**.
- *We were in Yogyakarta last month.*
- Salah: *in last month*, *the last week*.

### 3. Jumlah waktu + ago
**Ago** artinya *yang lalu*, dan selalu diletakkan **setelah** jumlah waktu.
- *two days ago* = dua hari yang lalu
- *ten minutes ago* = sepuluh menit yang lalu
- *a long time ago* = dahulu kala

Kesalahan umum orang Indonesia: *before two days* (dari terjemahan *dua hari sebelumnya*). Yang benar: **two days ago**.

### 4. In / on / at untuk waktu tertentu
Aturan dari A1 tetap berlaku: **in** 2019, **in** May, **on** Friday, **on** 17 August, **at** 7 o'clock.
- *I was born in 2008.*
- *She was in Bali on her birthday.*

### Posisi dalam kalimat
Biasanya keterangan waktu ada di **akhir** kalimat, tetapi boleh juga di **awal**:
- *I was at the market yesterday.*
- *Yesterday I was at the market.*

lessons.title: There Was and There Were
lessons.summary: Mendeskripsikan apa yang ada di suatu tempat di masa lalu.
objectives: Menggunakan there was dengan benda tunggal/tak terhitung dan there were dengan benda jamak
Membuat kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan: There wasn't..., Were there any...?
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Dari there is/are ke there was/were
Di A1 kamu sudah belajar **there is / there are** (ada). Untuk masa lalu, kita cukup mengubah *to be*-nya:

| Present | Past | Dipakai dengan |
| --- | --- | --- |
| there is | **there was** | benda tunggal atau tak terhitung (*a cat, some water*) |
| there are | **there were** | benda jamak (*two cats, some people*) |

- *There was a big tree in front of my old house.* (Dulu ada pohon besar di depan rumah lamaku.)
- *There were twenty guests at the party.* (Ada dua puluh tamu di pesta itu.)
- *There was some rice in the kitchen.* (Ada sedikit nasi di dapur — *rice* tak terhitung.)

### Kalimat negatif
| Negatif | Contoh |
| --- | --- |
| there **wasn't** a/an... | *There wasn't a bus at the station.* |
| there **wasn't any** + tak terhitung | *There wasn't any milk.* |
| there **weren't any** + jamak | *There weren't any taxis.* |

Ingat aturan **some/any** dari A1: *some* untuk kalimat positif, *any* untuk negatif dan pertanyaan.

### Pertanyaan dan jawaban singkat
- **Was there** a swimming pool at the hotel? — *Yes, there was. / No, there wasn't.*
- **Were there any** good shops? — *Yes, there were. / No, there weren't.*

### Aturan penting
Pilih was/were berdasarkan **kata benda pertama** setelahnya:
- *There was a sofa and two chairs.* (kata pertama *a sofa* → was)
- *There were two chairs and a sofa.* (kata pertama *two chairs* → were)

### Tips untuk penutur bahasa Indonesia
Kata *ada* dalam bahasa Indonesia bisa berarti *have* atau *there is/was*. Jangan katakan *Yesterday have a festival in my town*. Yang benar: **There was a festival in my town yesterday.**

lessons.title: How Was It? Places, Events and Feelings
lessons.summary: Menceritakan di mana kamu berada, acara yang kamu hadiri, dan bagaimana perasaanmu.
objectives: Bercerita singkat tentang di mana kamu berada dan bagaimana rasanya
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi, coba latihan berbicara, dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Menceritakan pengalaman dengan was/were
Sekarang kamu bisa menggabungkan semua yang sudah dipelajari di unit ini untuk bercerita: **di mana** kamu berada, **acara apa**, dan **bagaimana perasaanmu**.

*Last Saturday I was at my cousin's wedding. There were about two hundred guests. The food was delicious and everyone was very happy.*

### Kosakata perasaan (feelings)
| English | Indonesia |
| --- | --- |
| excited | bersemangat, antusias |
| nervous | gugup |
| proud | bangga |
| scared | takut |
| bored | bosan |
| relaxed | santai, tenang |
| disappointed | kecewa |

### Kosakata acara dan tempat (events and places)
*a concert* (konser), *a wedding* (pernikahan), *a birthday party* (pesta ulang tahun), *a football match* (pertandingan sepak bola), *an exhibition* (pameran), *a stadium* (stadion), *a museum* (museum), *a hall* (aula/gedung).

### Bored atau boring?
Ini kesalahan yang sangat umum.
- **-ed** menjelaskan **perasaan orang**: *I was bored.* (Saya merasa bosan.)
- **-ing** menjelaskan **sifat benda/situasi** yang menyebabkan perasaan itu: *The film was boring.* (Filmnya membosankan.)

| Perasaan (-ed) | Penyebab (-ing) |
| --- | --- |
| bored | boring |
| excited | exciting |
| interested | interesting |
| tired | tiring |

### Pertanyaan yang berguna
- *Where were you last weekend?*
- *How was the concert? — It was amazing!*
- *Were you nervous before the exam?*
- *Who was there?*

### Tips berbicara
Jawab dengan lebih dari satu kalimat. Sebutkan **tempat**, **waktu**, **siapa yang ada di sana**, dan **perasaanmu**. Contoh: *I was at the stadium on Sunday. There were thousands of people. I was so excited!*
